usedFor: Each “New Booking” in anny opens a deal in HubSpot so reservations reach your pipeline.

bestTemplate.name: “New Confirmed Booking” in anny, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A confirmed booking is accepted business, so deals appear only for bookings you honor.

watchOut: “Updated Booking” fires on every change, so wiring it to “Create Deal” can create several deals.
